signature.name: Calgary Tower
signature.detail: The city's most recognizable landmark, with an observation deck offering sweeping views of downtown and the Rockies on clear days. Go early morning or near sunset for the best light and thinner crowds; it sits right in the downtown core and is easy to reach on foot or by transit.

signature.name: Calgary Zoo
signature.detail: One of Canada's top zoos, home to a wide range of animals and a well-regarded dinosaur park section. Allow a full half-day and check opening hours in advance, as they vary by season.

signature.name: Heritage Park Historical Village
signature.detail: A large living-history museum that recreates life in western Canada with historic buildings and costumed interpreters. It is a seasonal attraction, so confirm it is open before you go and plan several hours to explore.

signature.name: Glenbow Museum
signature.detail: The city's main museum of art and history, with strong collections on western Canadian and Indigenous cultures. Check current opening status and hours before visiting, as the museum has undergone changes.

signature.name: Prince's Island Park
signature.detail: A downtown island park along the Bow River, popular for walks, picnics and river views. It is free and easy to reach from the Eau Claire area; go on a warm afternoon for the liveliest atmosphere.

signature.name: Calaway Park
signature.detail: The region's main amusement park, a family favorite just outside the city with rides and shows. It is seasonal and best visited on a weekday to avoid the longest lines.

transport: Light rail (CTrain) about $3.50 a ride; taxis and rideshares moderate
